description: Graph Insights — embedded knowledge graph panels within the Reflection Dashboard showing cross-run patterns, rule influence, pipeline events, step provenance, and workflow version lineage. Also includes a compact patterns widget on the Active Dashboard and pattern indicators in run history.

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

target.label: Required element for Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

target.label: Required element for Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

assertions.description: Required element 2 for state Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

target.label: Required element for Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

groups.description: The Reflection Dashboard includes a 'Graph Insights' section that embeds CrossRunPatternsPanel, RuleInfluencePanel, PipelineEventsTimeline, StepProvenanceTimeline, and WorkflowVersionLineage as sub-panels within the existing reflection view.
groups.name: Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

target.label: Required element for Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

target.label: Required element for Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

assertions.description: Required element 2 for state Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

target.label: Required element for Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

groups.description: The Active Dashboard shows a compact TopPatternsWidget that summarizes active cross-run patterns (recurring findings and fix oscillations), auto-hiding when no patterns exist.
groups.name: Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Run History Pattern Indicator

target.label: Required element for Run History Pattern Indicator

groups.description: Run history rows show a small orange badge with the count of active cross-run patterns for each workflow, helping users spot problematic workflows at a glance.
groups.name: Run History Pattern Indicator

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Graph Data Flow Architecture

target.label: Required element for Graph Data Flow Architecture

groups.description: All graph panels consume data from the /graph/* MCP endpoints via React Query hooks (useGraphAnalytics.ts) with 30-second stale time and 60-second polling interval. Event-driven refresh (useGraphDataRefresh.ts) invalidates queries when tasks or reflections complete.
groups.name: Graph Data Flow Architecture

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Graph Insights Navigation

target.label: Required element for Graph Insights Navigation

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Graph Insights Navigation

target.label: Required element for Graph Insights Navigation

groups.description: Graph insight panels are accessible through multiple navigation paths: embedded in the Reflection Dashboard tab, as standalone tabs (element-reliability, pipeline-events, rule-influence, unified-search, workflow-versions), and via the global Cmd+K palette.
groups.name: Graph Insights Navigation

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Data Refresh Behavior

target.label: Required element for Data Refresh Behavior

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Data Refresh Behavior

target.label: Required element for Data Refresh Behavior

assertions.description: Required element 2 for state Data Refresh Behavior

target.label: Required element for Data Refresh Behavior

groups.description: Graph data refreshes on two cadences: React Query polling (30s stale, 60s interval) and event-driven invalidation via useGraphDataRefresh when tasks or reflections complete. The TopPatternsWidget auto-hides when no active patterns exist.
groups.name: Data Refresh Behavior

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Cross-Panel State Consistency
assertions.precondition: Both TopPatternsWidget and CrossRunPatternsPanel are visible (active patterns exist)

target.label: Required element for Cross-Panel State Consistency

groups.description: The pattern count shown in TopPatternsWidget (Active Dashboard) must match the data shown in CrossRunPatternsPanel (Reflection Dashboard) since both consume the same useCrossRunPatterns hook. Similarly, PatternIndicator badges in run history must reflect the same pattern counts.
groups.name: Cross-Panel State Consistency
